Edit PDF

Add text, shapes, highlights and images.

A real in-browser PDF editor. Add text boxes, rectangles, ellipses, lines, highlights and images, then export a flattened PDF with your changes baked in.

Processed entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded, stored or retained by Paperly.

How Edit PDF works

  1. Add a PDF and pick a tool from the left palette.
  2. Click the page to place content, then drag to position it.
  3. Export a new PDF with your edits flattened in.

Limitations

Results depend on the input document. Always keep the original file until you have verified the output.

Related tools

  • Sign PDF — Draw or type a signature and place it anywhere.
  • Watermark PDF — Brand or mark pages with tasteful watermarks.
  • Organize PDF — Reorder, rotate and remove pages visually.
